condition: Live Olympus route in desktop Edge with Quest base-geometry budget and profiling mode (no debug boundary meshes). Real network DEM and imagery, normal selection, worker terrain publication and tour following; paired images hold the same scene/state synchronously. CPU preparation is a synchronous batch-settle stress operation, not normal per-frame or native GPU timing. Detail monitoring samples at 250 ms; native acceptance remains separate.

limitations: Callback spacing and JavaScript/render submission are not GPU time or compositor-delivered FPS.
Missed callbacks are estimated from the reported XR refresh rate; use OVR Metrics Tool for device FPS, GPU time and thermal state.
WebGL counts reflect the last rendered frame in each window; texture count is not total GPU memory.
Playback and HUD counters are snapshots at the end of each window; transition events identify changes within a window.
HUD upload requests and logical RGBA source bytes are not measured GPU transfers. Counters restart when the route HUD is replaced.
